scenario: An authorised weekly snapshot includes privacy-bounded review, method, and trigger rows plus the exact active standard and prior proposal states.

apply declared candidate policy and preserve non-candidates

return owner decisions needed without editing standard

report counts denominators dates and human dispositions

propose description change with collision risk

create versioned change request against exact source hash
route through ctrl-compile ctrl-build independent ctrl-check and harness-maintainer release gates as applicable

verify deployed version and surface parity

scenario: One low-severity correction exists and the declared policy normally requires recurrence.

record policy reason and review window

separate containment from permanent standard change

keep unknown dispositions unknown
mark rate-based conclusions unavailable

do not infer decay or retirement

retain criterion

scenario: The owner rejected the same proposal last week and there is no materially new evidence.
must: preserve rejected status and decision provenance
do not re-propose on cadence alone
state what materially new evidence could reopen it
continue monitoring under policy

scenario: A useful accepted rule would increase runtime context and no obsolete rule is clearly safe to remove.

consider progressive disclosure split or advisory placement
keep necessary rule if owner accepts and target budget validates
record residual cost and test
